set.body: Outcome: complete authorized five-part tranche: versioned scalar estimate interchange; bounded disk-backed input/output with Rust/R round-trip; reused weighted QR scratch; explicit shared-weight batch path; end-to-end numerical, time, allocation and peak-memory qualification. Preserve first-level kernels, independent-subject semantics and extreme-weight failures. Scope docs/GROUP_PORTABLE_EXECUTION.md, fmri-group, narrowly fmridataset file source, scripts/evidence. No remote publication.
set.title: Portable group estimates and reusable weighted execution
